subject: Kickoff: infinite-width uncertainty & calibration audit
body: Team — kicking off the infinite-width uncertainty project for the trust-theory portfolio, grounded in our open-source release on the uncertainty properties of neural networks' implicit priors in the infinite-width limit. We treat the function-space prior of an ensemble of infinitely-wide networks as a Gaussian process (the NNGP), put a softmax link on top for multi-class classification, and sample the posterior with parallelized elliptical slice sampling in JAX. What this unlocks: a calibration audit others can actually run — a direct comparison of NNGP calibration against finite-width analogues, which is exactly the evidence we keep getting asked for in model reviews. Milestones inside our window (Feb 16 – May 4): repro the ESS pipeline on the precomputed Myrtle-10 kernels by mid-March; calibration comparison report by late April; decision on productizing as an internal service at close. Deshawn will follow up on staffing. — Ximena
